crawl_completion.name: crawl_completion
crawl_completion.value: ("crawl_logs"."status" = 'running' AND "crawl_logs"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("crawl_logs"."status" = 'success' AND "crawl_logs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "crawl_logs"."reason" IS NULL) OR ("crawl_logs"."status" = 'failed' AND "crawl_logs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("crawl_logs"."reason")) > 0)
